name: techdella/toc
title: Table of contents
description: 'On this page' list built server-side from the post's H2/H3 headings (ids are added to the headings automatically). Sticky on desktop, a collapsible <details> on phones; highlights the current section when JS runs.

techdella.help: Reads the current post (or postId). Place it in the post template's sidebar, or at the top of the content. depth 2 lists H2s only. items are a preview-only example. Hidden when the post has fewer than minItems headings.
